title: Ekans's Favorite Snack Can Knock It Out

direction.premise: Bird Pokémon eggs are Ekans's favorite food, but swallowing one whole can get it stuck and make Ekans faint.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Ekans's favorite food becomes the risky meal that can knock it out.
direction.openLoop: What happens when Ekans's favorite egg will not go down?
direction.payoff: Ekans can swallow prey whole, but a stuck bird egg can turn its favorite food into a fainting risk.
direction.engagementQuestion: Favorite food or worst snack, which label fits Ekans?

voice.instructions: Use a playful, suspenseful tone. Hit the hook with alarm, make the jaw reveal feel surprising, then slow down for the stuck-egg payoff.

scenes.headline: EGGS CAN KNOCK EKANS OUT
scenes.narration: Ekans's favorite snack can knock it out.
scenes.caption: ITS FAVORITE FOOD HAS A CATCH

scenes.headline: BIRD EGGS, SWALLOWED WHOLE
scenes.narration: Bird Pokémon eggs are Ekans's favorite food, swallowed whole.
scenes.caption: EGGS GO DOWN WHOLE

scenes.headline: ITS JAW CAN DETACH
scenes.narration: Ekans can detach its jaw to swallow prey larger than itself.
scenes.caption: A JAW BUILT TO SWALLOW BIG

scenes.headline: BUT THE EGG CAN GET STUCK
scenes.narration: But that whole egg can get stuck inside Ekans.
scenes.caption: WHOLE EGG → STUCK

scenes.headline: FAVORITE FOOD, FAINTING END
scenes.narration: Its favorite food then ends with Ekans fainting.
scenes.caption: FAVORITE FOOD → FAINTED

scenes.headline: FAVORITE FOOD OR WORST SNACK?
scenes.narration: Favorite food or worst snack, which label fits Ekans?
scenes.caption: FAVORITE OR WORST?
